findings.title: Baskıyı kaldıran geniş teşhir
findings.claim: The focus presents Jahannam as an exposure with no selective perimeter: the event is made broad across the audience and directed toward the deniers as an unavoidable encounter.
findings.mechanism: The repeated focus forms عَرَضْنَا and عَرْضًا carry both the presentation act and a width register; 69:18 independently presents all people with nothing concealed, while 46:20 presents those who disbelieved to the Fire. Their contact changes the focus from a bare notice of punishment into a broad, compulsory exposure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive that the openness of the display removes an evasive margin, not merely that Hell is visible.
findings.containment: The ordinary deliberate act of presenting Hell remains intact. The width register is a contextual resonance, not a claim of literal geometric measurement or an exclusion of the presentation branch.

epistemic.reason: The candidate's cross-run support is trusted and citable, and the two independent target connections supply explicit presentation and no-concealment contacts.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesnenin uzunluğuna karşıt en boyutunu belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated focus root form carries a width-and-spread register alongside its deliberate presentation form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 69:18 presents all people on that Day and states that nothing hidden remains concealed.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's width register meets the wider no-concealment presentation, making the exposure read as spread across the full field of recipients rather than narrowed to a selective view.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The display becomes broad, nonselective exposure that leaves no interpretive perimeter around the presented destination.
branch_activations.boundary: This is not a literal measurement of Jahannam and does not replace the ordinary presentation act with the spatial branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir fail, bir nesneyi muhatabın görmesi veya değerlendirmesi için ortaya koyar.
branch_activations.carrier: The transitive focus verb and its cognate accusative carry a deliberate act of placing Jahannam before a recipient for apprehension.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 46:20 directly depicts those who disbelieved being presented to the Fire and receiving recompense.
branch_activations.activation: The external presentation-to-the-Fire scene returns through the same focus presentation relation and turns the recipient's encounter into the operative event.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Jahannam is not merely named as a future fate; it is brought before the deniers as a compulsory object of sight.
branch_activations.boundary: The parallel does not claim that the focus reproduces every detail of 46:20 or that this resonance displaces the ayah's own judgment frame.

findings.title: İnkâr edilen hedefin karşıya konması
findings.claim: The focus turns the denied destination itself into what is placed before the deniers for direct apprehension.
findings.mechanism: The focus's presentation verb and cognate accusative establish a deliberate presenting-for-seeing relation; 46:34 presents the disbelievers to the Fire and asks them to recognize its truth, while 79:36 makes the Blaze manifest to whoever sees. These wider contacts make the focus's display carry an evidentiary confrontation rather than a mere mention.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices the judgment scene closing the distance created by denial: the destination is made present as the thing to be faced.
findings.containment: The finding stays within B002's presenting-for-seeing core. It does not turn the focus into a dialogue, a sales scene, or a claim that either parallel supplies the wording of 18:100.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk support is legacy_unbound and non-citable, while the focus surface and independent inter-surah connections directly support the retained B002 relation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir fail, bir nesneyi muhatabın görmesi veya değerlendirmesi için ortaya koyar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus presents Jahannam through a transitive verb reinforced by its cognate accusative, with the deniers as the target class.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 46:34 makes the disbelievers face the Fire as a truth to acknowledge, and 79:36 makes the Blaze manifest to whoever sees.
branch_activations.activation: Both wider scenes return through the focus's presentation-for-seeing relation and sharpen it into a direct confrontation with the previously denied destination.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The display is an evidentiary encounter in which denial's object is placed before the deniers.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not claim that the focus contains the surrounding speech of 46:34 or the universal audience of 79:36.

findings.title: Örtülü görüşten zorunlu açıklığa
findings.claim: The focus's emphatic display can be read against a preceding condition of covered sight as a reversal from concealment to unavoidable disclosure.
findings.mechanism: The focus's repeated presentation form carries the exposure event; the supplied retrospective identifies the 18:101 covered-sight condition, and 69:18 independently supplies a wider presentation in which nothing hidden remains concealed. Their contact changes display from simple visibility into a forced reversal of selective perception.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the pressure in the clear display: the audience is brought past the condition that had screened the destination.
findings.containment: 18:101 is retained as qualified contextual evidence from a legacy walk, not as independently reanalyzed Arabic in this packet. The finding does not claim that every surrounding sight image forms one global system.

epistemic.reason: Both retrospective supports are legacy_unbound and non-citable; the focus return is explicit in their payloads, while 69:18 supplies an independent packet-level wider trigger.
